title: DO LARGE GPT MODELS DISCOVER MORAL DIMENSIONS IN LANGUAGE REPRESENTATIONS? A TOPOLOGICAL STUDY OF SENTENCE EMBEDDINGS.

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing a 'fairness dimension' using the linear span of vector differences between polar moral concepts (e.g., responsible vs. irresponsible, beneficial vs. harmful) and utilizing topological data analysis (simplicial complexes) to project and cluster high-dimensional sentence embeddings to observe the separation between fair and unfair moral judgments.
